action_items.detail: Browser lane is blocked. Playwright needs /pw-browsers/chromium_headless_shell-1246 (screenshot_tool needs -1243), but only chromium_headless_shell-1208 is installed. The rules forbid installing browsers. Because of this, none of the 8 UI criteria could be checked in a browser: login page, no signup UI, redirect, dashboard cards/OMR format/chart, category forms and their inline 'Required' messages, report table/charts, 'No data for this period' message, date error message, Settings clear dialog. The check 'auth-login-and-guard' is saved and can be re-run by name once the browser is fixed.

test_tscheck_zz_clear_sample.py ran Clear sample data, as the briefing allowed. All 376 sample records are gone. Only user record left: one tscheck-own sale (2 x 5 = 10.000, 2026-10-15). Dashboard now shows net revenue 10.000. Re-running test_tscheck_profit_formulas.py on the empty DB still passes but proves little. Re-seed before UI retests.
Hand-calc check for Jun and Jul 2026 matched exactly before the clear. No 'Reload sample data' text was found in the frontend source. The UI side of this could not be checked.
